name: 65020 · Camdenton, MO
findings: ZIP 65020 (Camdenton) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65020 (Camdenton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
